request.style: Latin, Gregorian chant, penitential psalm sung by a low male schola in unison, slow and hushed, no instruments, Phrygian mode, dark candlelit chapel, contrite, 54 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Miserere mei, Deus
secundum magnam misericordiam tuam

[Verse]
Et secundum multitudinem miserationum tuarum
dele iniquitatem meam

[Verse]
Amplius lava me ab iniquitate mea
et a peccato meo munda me

[Outro]
Miserere mei, Deus
